snippet.title: Quest Master | Water Dungeon Theme Update | Out Now!
snippet.description:
Save 20% on Quest Master ► http://apo.gg/QuestMaster
Quest Master is a Zelda-like dungeon maker, now in Steam Early Access, inspired by classic dungeon crawlers. Craft your own dungeons, filled with puzzles, traps, and monsters, and challenge other players’ creations in solo or local co-op!
The Second Major Update has arrived, bringing the Water Dungeon Theme, Deepcoral Cove! Dive into a whole new world of mechanics and features:
New Items & Mechanics:
 • Flippers: Swim through water and dive for hidden treasures.
 • Grappleshot: Pull yourself or objects across long distances.
 • And much more!
Unleash your imagination and start creating your Zelda-like dungeons with new items and game-changing mechanics!

DISCORD: ► https://discord.gg/apogee
X / TWITTER: ► https://twitter.com/apogee_ent
THREADS: ► https://threads.net/apogeeentertainment
INSTAGRAM: ► https://www.instagram.com/apogeeentertainment/
FACEBOOK: ► https://www.facebook.com/ApogeeEntertainment
TIKTOK: ► https://www.tiktok.com/@apogeeentertainment
-
Video Credits:

Produced by Kyle Blessing & Jeron Moore
Directed by Kyle Blessing
Edited by Kyle Blessing
Motion Graphics by Klevin MacKlaverty
Trailer Music Composer: Tim Stoney
Quest Master Theme by Chipper Hammond
Additional Audio & SFX Support: Brent Houston
Executive Producer: Jeron Moore
Special Thanks: Scott Miller, Julian Creutz, Klevin MacKlaverty,
Thomas Lessa, Guilianno Bessa, Chipper Hammond, Wayne Strange, 
Tomas Palazzi, Tim Stoney, Sam Osteroff, Steven Blackburn, 
Devon Johnson, and Nick Perrin
